# The FY2026 school budget, three ways

The budget the School Committee approved on 12 March 2025, the budget MUNIS opened FY2026 with, and the FY2026 column of the district's FY2027 workbook, compared line by line.

## What it shows

- **MUNIS opened FY2026 $500,000 above the approved budget.** The 12 March 2025 documents print TOTAL BUDGET $25,787,474; the Town's period 12 report holds an original appropriation of $26,287,474 across 259 accounts.
- **The FY2027 workbook's FY2026 column follows MUNIS, not March.** 238 of its 250 lines with money have a MUNIS account at the same amount under the same code. It sums to $26,287,475.93 and differs from March on 29 lines, netting $499,998.98.
- **221 of the March budget's 254 lines with money land in MUNIS** at the same amount under the same code; 8 more land under another code, and 4 groups of lines went into one account.
- **Five copies of the March budget print the same total and 3 different salary pages.** The extract is the one whose lines tie to the column sums it prints.

What it does not show: which of the changes between March and MUNIS are the $500,000 and which are money moved between lines. Both look the same here. See *What this does not establish*.

## Which document is the March budget

Five copies dated 12 March 2025 are held. All print TOTAL BUDGET $25,787,474. The extract, `sources/data/fy26-approved-budget-lines.csv`, is **FINAL FY26 Town Manager's Target Budget Approved 3-12-25**:

- it prints cents, and its 390 lines sum to the column sums it prints under the totals ($9,117,566.49, $16,669,908.70, $25,787,475.19); its footnote says the printed TOTAL BUDGET is $1.19 under them;
- salaries, budget: the printed lines miss that sum by $0.02, $0.02, inside half a cent a line, because the workbook behind it holds cells past the cent (FinCom `.xlsx`, E332 = 60783.3504 for E.S. Administrative Secretary);
- every group subtotal it prints (5) foots to its lines;
- the School Department's own *FY26 School Dept. Approved Budget 3-12-25* prints the same figure on every line, rounded to the dollar.

## What this does not establish

- **Which lines the $500,000 went to.** The workbook's FY2026 column is $499,998.98 above March across 29 lines, and 7 pairs of those changes cancel to within rounding (ACE General Supplies $6,000 and ACE General School Supplies -$6,000; Curriculum Adoption/System -$40,000 and Curriculum Adoption $40,000; Collaborative Tuitions -$480,204 and Circuit Breaker (70% = $422,408) (75% = 452,580) $480,204.44; Executive Secretaries/Supt. $5,000 and Remote Coordinator -$5,000; Business Office/Clerical $71,000 and Human Resource Specialist -$71,000; Processing Coordinator Stipends -$16,800 and SALARIES CLERICAL $16,800; Special Detail/Athletic Events $7,100 and Athletic Special Detail -$7,100). A pair like that fits money moved between lines, a recoding, or two unrelated changes of one size; nothing here tells them apart, and an addition looks the same as a reallocation. Registered in `sources/data/money-gaps.csv`; it closes with the line-item budget as voted at Town Meeting, or the district's own allocation of the $500,000.
- **That the $500,000 is the free cash article.** The School Committee minutes of 2 April 2025 list "Article to supplement the Lunenburg schools fiscal 2026 operating budget by $500,000" (`sources/meetings/text/school-committee/2025-04-02-minutes-rr2026-11-23.txt`, line 245), and the Finance Committee of 27 January 2026 speaks of "the additional $500,000 for schools" (`sources/meetings/text/finance-committee/2026-01-27-minutes-7619.txt`, line 46). Neither gives a line. The amount matches; that it is the same money is a reading.
- **Which coding is right** where a line sits under one code in March and another in MUNIS. Nothing here settles it (see `scripts/check_function_crosswalk.py`).
- **Why the copies differ.** Three salary pages under one total is what the documents print; which was voted is not stated in any of them.
